title: eludite.nuget.install input
description: Install a package in a project (Browse's Install). The project files (or Directory.Packages.props under Central Package Management) are edited with their formatting kept, then restored unless the setting nuget.restoreOnChange is off; a failed restore leaves the edit, with its errors in the answer and the Error List. Class execute under the solution policy's `nuget.change` (agents are asked by default). Every change is audited with the project, the package and the version.

version.description: The version (default: the newest, prerelease per `prerelease`).

project.description: A project of the open solution: its name (`App`) or the absolute path of its project file.

projects.description: Several projects (the solution scope's check boxes).

items.description: A project of the open solution: its name (`App`) or the absolute path of its project file.
